body: LEAD D2/D4 DISPOSITION: ACCEPT the construction amendments; REJECT the accompanying P1 objection. ADR 0007 and the current board disposition both require the real-transcript research gate to remain open and to block movie implementation; the current plan is correct on that point. The plan now sharpens D2: native integer PTS plus exact rational timebase/origin/rendition; DTS decode provenance only; checked native-PTS to edition-playback composition with edit-list semantics; separate clock repair, track composition, and edition correspondence; mapped/gap/outside/no-correspondence/ambiguous outcomes; no functional inverse; occurrence and rendition retained in support. D4 now makes acoustic cluster/activity, shot-scoped face track, cross-shot appearance continuity, and narrative EntityId non-convertible; character grounding is interval-local proposal; visibility, emission path, vocalization, diegesis, and rendition are orthogonal; Speech context follows accepted attribution only. PTS/DTS reorder, VFR rational rescale, edit-list/hold, alternate occurrence, scoped-ID collision, listener permutation, overlap/song/crowd/device, and dub-swap courts are mandatory. The factorial aggregate-success trap is accepted: holding marginal provider outputs fixed while permuting edit list, visible face, rendition, and sung overlap must not change lawful binding except through typed inputs; missing/substituted joins must remain unresolved. No ADR amendment is needed for these refinements.
